scope: frozen histogram-fitted prefix code and a raw reference on disjoint categorical regions of one snapshot

checks.split: explicit train/guard/test sizes select contiguous disjoint regions; changing guard and ignored tail symbols has no effect; short snapshots produce insufficient_data
checks.frozen_model: fit from training only with deterministic ties; preserve model bytes across differing held-out inputs; account for a fixed escape and raw labels for all unseen categories
checks.exactness: independent bitstring and heap references verify model, conditional and raw lengths; decode held-out bytes using only the serialized model
checks.controls: exercise matched and shifted distributions, relabeling including tied counts, malformed payloads, budget limits and later valid rows
checks.install: preserve prior CLI outputs and run the full conformance matrix

limits: one training region and one validation region per snapshot, with a frozen frequency-fitted prefix code. No temporal independence assumption, model selection, structural gain or scientific calibration.
